title: A. BULCHA KAIMTICH DUREESA
paragraphs: Gaafa toko, namichi toko Yesoti d'ufe waan jed'e, “Aabbo, anini waan dansa akami tolchu male aka jireenna hegeri argad'u?”
Yesoni waan jed'eeni, “Waan dansaa maafi na gaafatta? Nami dansaani toko ch'alla. Yo jireenna argachu feete, seera ch'ufa guuti.” Namichi kaani waan jed'eeni, “Seera kami?”
Yesoni waan jed'eeni, “Inijeesiini d'iirafi nad'eeni wolbarate gaarayu wolintolfatini; inhatiini; inkiyyibiini; abbeetiifi haateti saalfad'u oboleesa kanke aka ufi jaalatu jaalad'u.”

Namichi kaani, “Anini seera kana ch'ufa ya guute; wonti d'ibiini anini tolchu male maani?” jed'eeni. Yesoni waan jed'eeni, “Yo d'uguma qit'e tahu feete, waan qabdu ch'ufa gurguri, hiyyeeyi qoodi, duuba durooma gubba argatta, kooti na gula deemi.”
Namichi kaani waan kana d'agaye jennaani aka hama lalefate kae iti d'aabate, waan inni guddo dureesatiifi.

Yesoni waan jara ufitiini jed'e, “Waan anini jed'u, Guddo jabaatti, aka dureeyiini Finna gubba argattu. Ammalle isaniti hima, Ira laaftu aka gaali qaa lime seenu, fulla dureeyiini Finna Waaqa argattu.”
Jari isaa waan kana d'ageennaani guddo mame waan jed'e, “Eentu dandae baafama re?”
Yesoni worra ilaale waan jed'eeni, Nami indandau, ammo Waaqi waan tokole indad'abu.
